claims.statement: For every ordinary path-star arity-count profile with 1<=m<=69 and every actual eligible lower-half p, the contract's exact selected integer primary payment margin is nonnegative; in fact it is positive on every scanned row. The stronger selected MASS margin A-b*delta*D_j is also positive on every scanned row.
claims.scope: Bounded exact computation over every (c2,c3,c4) with 1<=m=c2+c3+c4<=69, r_i in {2,3,4}, N=sum_i r_i, q=N+1, alpha=N+2. Use L=1+z, G=1+2z, B_r=L^r+z, F_r=sum_(h=0)^(r-2)L^h, Q=prod_i B_(r_i), H_i=prod_(h!=i)B_(r_h), C=GQ, T_i=GF_(r_i)H_i, P=C+zL^q; coefficients and Delta_k f=f[k+1]-f[k] are integer zero-extended. x is the least natural k with Delta_k P<0, including the terminal degree. Scan every natural p satisfying x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, and 2p<=alpha; j=p-2, delta=q-j, D_j=binom(N,j+1)-binom(N,j). Use current-p strict selectors e0=1[Delta_p A0<0], ei=1[Delta_p Ai<0], where A0=LQ+zL^N and Ai=G B_(r_i-1)H_i+zL^N. Let b=e0+sum_i r_i ei and A=sum_i r_i ei T_i[j], retaining every original tip tag multiplicity. Check the exact integer primary target margin (delta*C[j]-(delta-1)*C[j+1])*A-b*delta*D_j*C[j] and MASS margin A-b*delta*D_j. The result is bounded evidence only.
claims.reason: A separate exact-integer convolution scan agrees with the assigned evaluator and the shared controller instrument: 59,639 profiles, 68,129 eligible rows, no negative primary or MASS margins, with the reported positive extrema. This retains only the finite claim; the all-m predicates remain OPEN.
